title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
statement_short: Given two strings needle and haystack, return the index of the first occurrence of needle in haystack. Return -1 if needle is not part of haystack.
constraints: 1 <= haystack.length, needle.length <= 10^4, haystack and needle consist of lowercase English letters
hint: String lengths up to 10^4 permit O(n+m) linear search using matching pointers.
keywords: needle is not part of haystack
why_not: Right: Two Pointers (or Knuth-Morris-Pratt pattern matching) finds the target occurrence in O(n+m) time and O(1) space. Not Sliding Window: Sliding a fixed window takes O(n\*m) worst-case time without mismatch shift optimization. Not Binary Search: String characters are unsorted, preventing binary search comparisons. Not Trie: Building a prefix tree uses O(m) extra memory for a single target string.
